description: Hand-written questions over the sample transcripts in output/text. expected_sources lists transcript files (any one counts as a hit). Questions with answerable=false must be refused as insufficient context. Note: MMR keeps only the first occurrence of a repeated sentence, so the expected source is the first bulletin that carried the story.

cases.question: Tell me about the semiconductor facility in Gujarat
What did the Reserve Bank decide about the repo rate?
India against Australia in the T20 World Cup
What did the Finance Ministry report about direct tax collections?
Bilateral talks held by the External Affairs Minister
Special trains for the holiday rush
Supreme Court judgment on electoral reforms
joint military exercises by the defence forces
solar corridors announced by the renewable energy ministry
Who won the Wimbledon men's final?
What is the price of gold in Dubai?
